# rm01: shared draft-to-physical roster, unchanged-policy control

Base `2f0f534e8311ee597e516b11c2afca1bbf608060`, base bot
`leader_party_tuned`. Candidate `bots/pi_roster-map-control-01/` only.
Write IMPLEMENTATION.md. This is a foundational control, not a strength change;
inherit no cd01/dp01/profiler/shopping experiments. Do NOT pick the duo yet.

## Research and purpose

All60 sampled leader team-views contain Cassi/Issac, while a rank750 control also
uses them and loses heavily. A roster-only causal gain is unproved. Current
`draft.cpp` preferences and `route_plan.cpp`'s five physical types are separate
hardcoded lists. A future replacement can therefore select actors without their
routes. The SDK's draft enum expands the pair to two physical types and shifts
later physical enum values: casting enums is invalid. Runtime vectors and wire
slots0–5 accommodate one pair in five choices; packet upper bound251<1024 bytes.

The small necessary module is a single ordered roster description with explicit
draft-choice-to-physical-type expansion. Its interface must let picking and
route preparation consume the same policy and let focused tests verify mapping.
Keep this pure compile-time data/logic where practical, with no SDK live queries,
registry, callbacks, virtual classes, runtime role framework or coordination.
Two real consumers are draft selection and route preparation. Keep the interface
small; hide the enum expansion instead of asking callers to keep arrays aligned.

## Unchanged control contract

Preserve the complete existing12-choice preference order, selected choices,
and five-choice route template Heart/Marcella/Vesper/Ren/Vendetta, including
on3/4-choice maps. The planner currently computes unused trailing template
routes; trimming them changes fuel allocation and is OUT OF SCOPE.

Introduce a small shared header/module and replace the two hardcoded policy
lists with its outputs. Expansion must explicitly handle Cassi/Issac as two
physical actors so the future variant has a safe seam, but current selection
and route bodies remain identical. Do not add a selectable variant or flags.
Preserve route ordering, current per-body fuel-share formula, planner inputs,
packet bytes/type-keyed ownership, empty/partial fallback, and incremental writes.
Preserve the current caster estimate (Heart and Ren only) and every actor's
existing damage estimate; future Cassi classification belongs to the variant.
Do not change shopping, draft team-size handling, runtime priorities, shared
protocol, combat, navigation, bank thresholds or any other policy. No logs.

Prefer constexpr/std::array/span machinery that compiles to the same code for
the original policy. Do not deliberately add runtime allocation or work merely
to make the interface generic. A fixed-capacity expansion with explicit count
is acceptable if needed; ensure the actual five-body control loop remains exact.

## Focused checks

Exercise the production roster interface, and verify its actual consumption in
the draft/route producer rather than only testing a duplicated table. Cover
all enum mappings, pair expansion, preserved12-choice order and five-body route
template, uniqueness, and three/four/five-choice prefixes. A fixture using an
explicit pair-containing input can validate3/5/6 physical actor counts without
enabling it in production. Preserve type-keyed packet ownership, bounds and
partial/empty fallback. Use available existing planner differential/state tests
and real-SDK syntax checks; record actual results and limitations. No new live
ally/partner reads. No fake performance claims or bot-strength tournament on Pi.

## Frozen PC control gate

Review exact source and release-build with CLI5/current engine3. First compare
WASM to original champion
`a24ef0c56844e506694c48ed34e698c083a18fe7d9d74bf6c12ae355d1b448ac`.
If identical, identity plus focused checks suffice; do not run an80-game screen.
If different, run the eight existing screen maps against C02 both sides only
(16 matched games), normal fuel, zero VM faults. Compare original exact fixtures'
rosters, scores, final round/input and non-fuel event fingerprints; report fuel
separately. Any changed trajectory blocks attributing a subsequent difference
solely to the roster: diagnose/revise the control before a pair variant. Do not
relax this into a win-count gate after seeing results.

No upload, promotion or ranked change. A later variant must use this exact
reviewed control commit and have its own frozen strength/mechanism gates. The
current campaign's cd01 confirmation and dp01 rejection remain separate.
